gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zalando-sans-expan: Flat and confident, Turret Road draws round, parenthesis-like forms with no contrast at all, while Zalando Sans Expanded lets its wide-spaced letters breathe beneath. Give that body a little extra size.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zalando-sans-semie: Commanding from the first word, Turret Road builds its heading from rounded rods of a single weight, and Zalando Sans SemiExpanded follows in open-mouthed curves. One shouts a little; the other keeps talking.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei carries a gentle swing in weight from stem to serif, so its text has some texture against Turret Road's bold, unshaded lines. That tension is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-an: Modern and tidy, Turret Road keeps its round forms and pen-like lines. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique follows with a t whose crossbar matches its stem, and smooth curves that never catch the eye.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-ne: Rounded, pen-drawn and a bit imposing, Turret Road takes the top spot with parenthesis-like curves. And Zen Kaku Gothic New settles in below with open curves and no hairlines or swells, an approachable foil.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic reads smoothly, with no closed-up bowls to snag on, like following one thread along the line. Turret Road above it adds bold, pen-like roundness, giving the page a firm headline voice.
gen-gf-turret-road-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans opens a wide channel into every bowl. Turret Road, with its monoline parenthesis-round forms, feels bolder and more commanding beside that technical, approachable text.
gen-gf-turret-road-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab brings sturdy, technical slabs with a broad opening on every bowl-ended curve. And Turret Road, drawn with a technical pen's steadiness, gives the heading a bold, rounded authority above it.
gen-gf-underdog-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk shows no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere, which keeps the text clean and approachable under Underdog's expressive, horseshoe-wide c. Their shared lack of weight shift is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-alpino: Underdog's c opens wide like a horseshoe, and its curves never change weight, which gives the heading its commanding voice. Alpino below is cozy and casual, tall in the body and spaced tightly, so text feels snug.
